Name: More Apps for Mobile Phone and Mobile Phone Continued
Author: kindtoeverykind
Description:
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/q86qPwT.png[/img][/center]
These mods are simply app packs to be used for either [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/18901754]aedenthorn[/url]﻿'s [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6523]Mobile Phone[/url] mod or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/25104754]JoXW[/url]'s [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21017]Mobile Phone Continued[/url] mod. There are also different versions depending on if you want the phone to close or not after selecting the app -- only install one of these versions. Each app has its own folder within one of the zips, so just install the folders that you want. The apps simulate a key press, and are great for if you're like me and can't remember a bunch of different keys for different mods lol. If you want to change which key press is simulated, then simply open the content json in a text editor such as Notepad and change that part of the code (the code is very short, so it should be easy to find).

If you would like me to make an app for another mod, feel free to request it, and I'll see what I can do. :)

I have included apps for:
[list]
[*][url=https://github.com/Sparky56p/AnythingAnywhere]Anything Anywhere[/url]﻿'s Carpenter Build Menu - Default key: OemComma
[*][url=https://github.com/Sparky56p/AnythingAnywhere]Anything Anywhere[/url]﻿'s Wizard Build Menu - Default key: OemPeriod
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/518]Chests Anywhere[/url]﻿ - Default key: B
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11436]Deluxe Journal[/url]﻿ - Default key: F
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8505]Event Lookup[/url]﻿'s Available Events List - Default key: N
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/509]Experience Bars[/url]﻿ - Default key: X
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/31622]Ilucie's Location Tracker[/url]﻿ - Default key: F2
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9253]Investment Maximized[/url]﻿ - Default key: K
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/541]Lookup Anything[/url]﻿'s Search Function - Default key: F3 *Note that this is different from the default configuration, which must be changed in that mod's config for this one to work!
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3900]Noclip Mode[/url]﻿ - Default key: F11
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18224]Personal Combat Drone Redux[/url]﻿ - Default key: F7
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1930]Qi Exchanger[/url]﻿ - Default key: F6
[*][url=https://github.com/Lake1059/ResetTerrainFeatures_NET6]Reset Terrain Features (NET6)[/url]﻿ - Default key: L
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/39372]MH Skill Unlock History[/url]﻿ - Default key: F5
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11158]Smart Building[/url]﻿ - Default key: F9 *Note that this is different from the default configuration, which must be changed in that mod's config for this one to work!
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/31705]SproutSight Pro[/url]﻿ - Default key: F8
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6372]Stardew Aquarium[/url]﻿ - Default key: F5 *Note that this is different from the default configuration, which must be changed in that mod's config for this one to work! Also, this is the same key that Skill Unlock History uses by default - if installing both, then one of them must be changed.
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24689]What Do You Want[/url]﻿ - Default key: F2 *Note that this is the same key that Ilucie's Location Tracker uses by default - if installing both, then one of them must be changed.
[/list]

***NOTES***
[list]
[*]Ensure that the mod that each app is for is configured to use the same key press that is found in that app's content json. They must match!
[*]The Phone Open Versions leave the phone open after app selection, whereas the Phone Close Versions close the phone after app selection. *ONLY* download one version of the mods - do not install both.
[*]Make sure you have the version that goes with the Mobile Phone mod that you use -- original or continued.
[*]All files are in one zip - just delete the ones you don't want.
[/list]

[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/DCZFINl.png[/img][/center]
Download whichever apps you want and their requirements (this would be either [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/18901754]aedenthorn[/url]'s [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6523]Mobile Phone[/url] mod or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/25104754]JoXW[/url]'s [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21017]Mobile Phone Continued[/url] mod, as well as the original mods that the apps you want are targeting) and simply unzip/copy the contents of the zip files to your Mods folder.

Make sure that whatever key presses the apps' content jsons are targeting are the same key presses enabled in the configs of the original mods. These must match for the apps to work! You are welcome to change the content jsons to use different key presses than are targeted by default.


***NOTES***
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/541]Lookup Anything[/url]﻿ Search targets F3 because the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6523]Mobile Phone[/url]﻿ mod wouldn't allow for the default of LeftShift + F1 to be used. You must change [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/541]Lookup Anything[/url]﻿'s search toggle config to F3 for the app to work (or change both of them to some other single key press).
[/list]

[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/VCFHag8.png[/img][/center]
There are no config files for these mods, but which key presses they activate can be changed by simply editing the content jsons. Just make sure that they match whatever key presses are enabled in the original mods that the apps are for.


[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/u0BlcBJ.png[/img][/center]
Incompatible:
[list]
[*]Other [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6523]Mobile Phone[/url]﻿ or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21017]Mobile Phone Continued[/url]﻿ apps that target the same mods and/or key presses. Any key press incompatibilities can be resolved by editing the content jsons as mentioned above.
[/list]
Compatible:
[list]
[*]Everything else should be compatible.
[/list]

***NOTES***[list]
[*]These mods were made for 1.6, and compatibility with other game versions is untested. It is also untested with Android. If someone wants to convert these mods for use with other versions, they can do so and send me the file to add to the mod page.
[/list]

[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/fWuFsmu.png[/img][/center]
[list]
[*]Please do not reupload my mods as-is.
[*]Please do not reupload my mods' assets without permission and giving credit.
[*]Please do not involve generative AI with my mods.
[*]Please ask for my permission before uploading alterations or additions to my mods. This does not apply to translations. You do not need to get my permission for translations, but please send me the link so that I can add it to my mod page's description. :)
[*]Please credit me and link to my original mod if you post an alteration/addition to it.
[*]Please make my original mod a requirement for any alterations/additions, if possible.
[*]Please do not lock my mods or any alterations of them/additions to them behind a paywall. They must be provided for free. Also, please only post them on sites/pages that are relatively easy to access (so not, like, a members-only Naver post, for example).
[*]If I cannot be contacted in any way for over a month, you are allowed to upload alterations or additions to my mods, provided that you follow the other rules that I have specified on that mod's page.
[/list]

[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/IMXG1bI.png[/img][/center]
For coding:[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/18901754]aedenthorn[/url]﻿ for creating [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6523]Mobile Phone[/url]﻿, which makes these app packs possible, and for including example app packs, which were the basis for my app packs.
[/list]
For art:
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/ErraticPixel]ErraticPixel[/url]﻿ for the Reset Terrain Features app icon. Thank you so much for letting me use it!
[*]Other app icons were made by me. I'm no artist, but I hope they turned out decent enough!
[*][url=https://www.kdau.com/]kdau[/url]﻿ for their [url=https://www.kdau.com/scrollish]Stardew Valley Scroll Generator[/url]﻿, which I used to make headers for this mod page.
[/list]
And of course, credit goes to ConcernedApe (and those he employs) for Stardew Valley itself.


[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/DVO1ZSz.png[/img][/center]
Mods used in the screenshots:
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30074]﻿Chiikawa Phone Themes and Ringtones[/url]﻿
[*]﻿I'm having a hard time finding which mod the phone skin is from - if anyone knows, please tell me!
[/list]
For my other mod recommendations, please check out [url=https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1Kzqa0jhOHRm5fLzp4CkRKqr0ct2_xAJtfajcfeIhTus]this spreadsheet[/url]. (It's currently a work-in-progress, but I'm steadily adding more to it over time.)


[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/XmkVrTT.png[/img][/center]
If you encounter any issues, please post them in the Bugs section or the comments section with a LINK to your [url=https://smapi.io/log]SMAPI log[/url]. Do not post the text from the log or a screenshot from the log. This clogs up the page and makes it difficult for me to understand what's going on and help you. If you post text or a screenshot rather than a link, then I will tell you to provide a log next time and delete your submission.

The only time you are allowed to submit a report/comment about an issue without a link to your SMAPI log is if for some reason you literally cannot get one. If that is the case, please say so in your report/comment and provide as much detail about the problem as you can.
